```swift let center = NotificationCenter.default var token: NSObjectProtocol? token = center.addObserver(forName: MLModelCollection.didChangeNotification, object: nil, queue: nil) { [unowned self] note in guard let modelCollection = note.object as? MLModelCollection else { print("Model Collection notification's object is not a model collection") return } // Use updated model collection ... self.receivedUpdatedModelCollection(modelCollection) // Clean up notification registration. center.removeObserver(token!) } ```
